verdict.rationale: Founder Law's International Entrepreneur Parole page states specific qualifying dollar thresholds described as CPI-adjusted per USCIS, so at least one public claim is tied to an official USCIS figure. Nothing else in the pack shows government-data grounding, and there is no evidence of linked citations. missing for 10: USCIS processing-time or approval-rate data, FOIA statistics, official policy citations with links, broader evidence that public claims are routinely grounded in government sources.

support.subject: As a developer evaluating providers, the provider grounds its public claims in government data — USCIS processing data, FOIA statistics, or official policy citations with links
